title: Home Oxygen Therapy Reimbursement Note: Usage Pattern Share of the Equipment Month
content:
# Usage Pattern Share — Home Oxygen Therapy Equipment Months

**Rule.** For a Home Oxygen Therapy equipment month paid in full by the coverage, the month's fee is multiplied by the share of the day the order uses oxygen:

- by **60 percent** for an order for sleep only;
- by **50 percent** for an order for exertion only with at least one cylinder refill on record;
- by **80 percent** for an order for exertion and sleep with at least one cylinder refill on record;
- by **100 percent** for any other order.

The usage pattern is the one on the oxygen record's order; the cylinder refills are those in the patient's oxygen service history. The multiplication acts on the amount as it stands, without rounding.

## Condition table

| Usage pattern on the order | At least one cylinder refill on record | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| sleep only | either | 60 |
| exertion only | yes | 50 |
| exertion only | no | 100 |
| exertion and sleep | yes | 80 |
| exertion and sleep | no | 100 |
| any other pattern | either | 100 |

## Worked figures (hypothetical month's fee of 200.00)

| Order | Amount |
|---|---|
| sleep only | 200.00 multiplied by 60 percent: 120.00 |
| exertion only, refills on record | 200.00 multiplied by 50 percent: 100.00 |
| exertion and sleep, refills on record | 200.00 multiplied by 80 percent: 160.00 |
| exertion only, no refill on record | 200.00 |
